spec.kitLine: Activates when using Burst Skill; self
spec.assertion: Self Max HP grants (buffApply stat maxHpFlat, casterIdx===targetIdx) appear >=3x; re-keying the trigger to fullBurstEnter in a co-Burst-III fixture must produce MORE applications. Fails under the fullBurstEnter over-crediting model (and under any keying where the patch is a no-op).

First grant of the fight is the smallest tier; >=3 distinct magnitudes with max/min in [5.0, 9.0] (kit 5.76, loose upper bound for compounding Max HP base). Fails under equal tiers, a single flat grant, or an inverted/instant-max ladder.

spec.kitLine: Each subsequent triggers all before it
spec.assertion: Cumulative signature: tier-1-band applications strictly outnumber tier-3-band ones (tier 1 fires on every cast, tier 3 only from cast 3). Plus damage(faithful) > damage(highest-tier-only patch) > damage(skill1 removed). Fails under the 'only the newest tier is live' ladder, which inverts the count and loses the 30.09%-of-MaxHP delta.
Every self-grant has no finite expiresFrame inside the fight and no durationShots. Fails under a 'for N sec' windowed model.
No maxHpFlat buffApply with 2B as caster and a different target index; teammate totals byte-identical across every 2B counterfactual. Fails under an allies-scoped grant.

Halving the block's trigger count roughly doubles the rider's damage delta (ratio in [1.6, 2.5]). Fails under a one-shot 'fires once at 300' reading and under interval/shotFired keying, where the threshold patch moves nothing (ratio ~1).

Pruning flatDamage effects with atkPct ~167.45 removes >0 effects and lowers 2B's total. Fails if the rider is dropped or encoded at a different magnitude (the prune finds nothing and the guard trips).

spec.kitLine: ATK 6.16% of user's final Max HP
spec.assertion: Removing the atkOfMaxHpPct buff lowers damage; and with it removed, deleting skill1's Max HP ladder changes the total by EXACTLY zero. This isolates the HP->ATK coupling: fails under Max HP modelled inert (first delta 0) or under a second unstated ATK path (second delta non-zero).
Prune-delta > 0, and delta(2439.36)/delta(792) in [2.9, 3.3] — an ATK-independent magnitude pin (kit ratio 3.080). Fails on a mis-entered percentage or a merged single-hit encoding.
Prune-delta > 0 and the two component deltas sum to the whole-burst delta within 2% — nothing else hides in the burst slot, and neither component is double-counted.

Every burst-srcSlot damage event has fbMajorApplied !== true (burst-cast damage lands before the Full Burst window opens), guarded by a fixture check that the comp emits ZERO burst-slot damage once 2B's burst blocks are cleared. Fails if the burst hits are credited the +50% FB major.
it.skip — single partless boss, no HP pool in v1, so every target rule resolves identically; unobservable.

fixtures: PRIMARY controlComp('2b', false): the fixed Burst-III slot is dropped so 2B is the SOLE Burst III and casts on every rotation — required for the skill1 escalation to reach its third tier inside 180s (cd 40s), and it keeps the fixed-B3 unit's crit/charge buffs out of every magnitude reading. Liter (B1) + Crown (B2) still chain, so bursts actually cast (a lone B3 makes ZERO full bursts). SECONDARY controlComp('2b', true) is used for exactly one test — burst-cast vs full-burst-enter trigger identity is only observable when a second Burst III can steal a rotation. 12 hoisted 180s runs total. Per-unit damage claims are made by faithful-vs-counterfactual DELTA (damage events carry no documented unit field); Max HP claims use buffApply with casterIdx===targetIdx to exclude ally-granted Max HP (Crown grants Max HP to allies and would otherwise pollute the tier magnitudes).
gaps: burst 'Affects 1 enemy unit(s) with the highest remaining HP' — v1 boss is single + partless with no HP pool, so the selection clause is degenerate and no target rule is discriminable.

burst 2439.36% 'distributed damage' flavour — only observable through a distributedDamagePct consumer; 2B carries none and no control-comp ally supplies one, so the flavour tag is behaviourally inert.
skill2 167.45% rider crit-eligibility / per-kit noFb — MEASURED-only (flagged) quantities, never derivable from kit text.
skill2 'after firing 300 time(s)' rounds-vs-pulls — 2B is an AR with hitsPerShot 1, so the two readings coincide; only an MG-style carrier could separate them.
